behavior_quirks.quirk_1_user_created_branch_name_error: KNOWN BUG: _clean_user_project_runtime_snapshot is referenced but NOT defined. The user_created branch of /save-run raises NameError. Pinned in test_user_created_branch_has_latent_name_error.
behavior_quirks.quirk_2_runtime_origin_captured_but_not_: check_runtime_allowed unpacks runtime_origin but it is only used to gate execution — not to mutate state or pass to save_run/save_project.
behavior_quirks.quirk_3_save_project_runtime_timestamp_l: save_project's replay_metadata.runtime_timestamp is run_record.created_at.isoformat(), not utc_now_iso(). The two writes share the same timestamp.
behavior_quirks.quirk_4_save_project_replay_metadata_pro: save_project.replay_metadata.project_id is explicitly None — the repository fills it in from the existing row.
behavior_quirks.quirk_5_all_non_auth_responses_same_part: All 4 non-auth responses (allow_run, validate, model except, persist except, success) use partials/save_result.html. They differ only in context.
behavior_quirks.quirk_6_validate_form_uses_static_PROJEC: _validate_form checks project_type and scenario against hardcoded sets (PROJECT_TYPES, SCENARIOS), not the project record's actual values.
behavior_quirks.quirk_7_save_run_before_save_project: Order of writes is save_run first, then save_project. If save_run raises, save_project is NOT called.
